title: Read the southeast road for its sites: Biham and the systems around it, and beyond it Alnilam, Groombridge 1618, Pleione, Yed Posterior and Fomalhaut, every 150 minutes
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-17 19:26 UTC for orders.log ENT-042 (block ORACLE, P4 b): the south (Biham, Felis) is explored first for the next sites, with the north. The list: every system within two lanes of Biham (table lanes) that stood on census-roads, nearest first; Felis, Gliese 876 and GSC-0016 stay on census-worked (our routes use them) and GSC-0021, Tanglewood, GSC-0012 and Stormwatch on census-frontier, so no system stands on two lists of ours. The south is the pirate side of our space: the Korr stronghold Gliese 581 lies two jumps from Felis, and our record holds pirates at Felis (15 lines), Biham and Sualocin (3 each) (observations kind pirate, to 14:53 UTC). A census reads and leaves; the stance is flee (rule F2); a pirate met is filed for Military.
